steps.note: a recording open and untouched. Nothing has been saved, so the corner says nothing

THE TEST: the arrow on the controller was pressed, the file on disk is four seconds long, and the corner says the recording by name and that it saved. Before this the arrow simply vanished and that was the whole confirmation

the toast itself: the recording's own thumbnail, a green tick, and the recording named. This is the whole of what saving now says, and it is a separate panel from the window, which is why it needs its own picture
and it never showed a progress bar: this save landed well inside half a second, and a bar that flashes up for a fifth of a second is a flicker rather than a report
the second way in: the chord went to File ▸ Save and the corner said so the same way. One save path, so one thing said, however it was reached

THE THIRD WAY, and the reason this lives in the corner rather than in the window: Save in the box that asks before the window closes runs the commit and the WINDOW GOES when it lands. The corner outlives it and still says the recording saved
